title: NEW! Hot Tub, Sauna, City Skyline Views
description:
Introducing ~ Second Fiddle
City Views | Close to Broadway | Private Hot Tub & Sauna

Features to Love:
⇨ Colorful, playful design with fun wallpaper, unique artwork, and vibrant decor throughout.
⇨ Rooftop Oasis with a sauna, hot tub, fire pit, grill, lounge seating, games, and outdoor wet bar with TV overlooking the Nashville skyline.
⇨ Converted garage hangout with pool table, retro arcade game, Smart TV, and fun lighting.
⇨ Sleeps 12 | 7 beds | 4 ensuite bedrooms

The space
Second Fiddle is a real treat and just might become your new favorite place to stay in Music City! Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and so much fun inside! 

As you walk in, the entry level welcomes you with the first ensuite bedroom featuring a Queen-over-King bunk bed and artwork inspired by the home’s namesake — The Second Fiddle, a must-visit spot while you’re out enjoying Broadway. Just off the entry is the converted garage hangout space where the pool table steals the show, but there's a lot more to see. You’ll also find a vintage arcade game, convertible pool and ping pong table, Smart TV, and a super fun HEX ceiling that changes colors with the music. Connect via Bluetooth and start the dance party!

Upstairs, the large open living space is full of personality with unique chairs, a playful “Keep Off!” rug, and plenty of room for your crew to spread out. The fully stocked kitchen has everything you need for meals at home (coffee’s on us!), plus bar seating at the island for gathering together. Off the kitchen, you’ll find another themed bedroom — the colorful skateboard Picasso room 🎨.
The upper-level features two additional bedrooms, including the King primary suite and a twin bedroom with super fun wallpaper and playful design details throughout.

Your rooftop is stocked! It features a sauna and a hot tub for relaxing, and fun details like a fire pit, cozy seating, and a grill for cooking with friends. Bonus are the Nashville city views - you have a perfect viewing spot from the hot tub! 

🎙️Welcome to Music City!
You're in East Nashville - a great neighborhood known for its local restaurants, live music, and laid-back charm.
- 5 mins to Dutch Bros, Retrograde and Jack’s Barbecue. Also a must: Redheaded Stranger – Neighborhood Taco Shop that is a Nashville tourist AND local favorite. 
- 5 min drive to Topgolf and Germantown neighborhood, don't miss Little Nat's! 
- 10 min drive to Broadway, Music Row, Bridgestone
- 15 min drive to Grand Ole Opry and Nissan Stadium

🛏️For Rest (Sleeps 12)
- First Floor: Queen over King Bunkbed Room with ensuite
- Second Floor: Queen Guest Bedroom with ensuite 
- Third Floor: Double Twin Guest Bedroom with ensuite
- Third Floor: Primary King Bedroom with Primary ensuite
- Additional sleeping option: Air mattress is provided. 

✓ The Essentials - All Included in your stay: 
- Premium full-size bath products in every bathroom/kitchen. We provide body wash, shampoo, conditioner, lotion, and hand soap.
- We provide a starter kit of everything you’ll need to kick off your stay: paper towels, toilet paper, dish soap, laundry pods, and more.
- Coffee is on us! Complimentary grounds from Nashville’s favorite, The Well.
- Free Parking On-site. (2 spaces available in the driveway to the right)
- High-speed Wi-Fi
- Washer and Dryer 

This home is proudly managed by Kalos Dwellings. Please reach out if we can answer any questions for you! 💛

Guest access
It's all yours! Guests will have 100% access to the entire home during their stay!
For your convenience, we provide you with self check-in instructions so that you can let yourself in upon arrival.

This home is proudly managed by Kalos Dwellings. 
Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions, we're here to help.

Other things to note
- Parking: There are 2 spaces available in the driveway to the right.
- Minimum age to rent the home is 25. 
- Pets: Apologies, no furry friends are allowed at the home. We appreciate your understanding on this
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn’t happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.
